blocks.text: Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) Chair and CEO Jose “Joey” Javier Reyes refuted rumors that he had resigned from his post after his previously-approved business-class privilege for an official trip to Spain was withdrawn. The rumors arose after Reyes expressed his frustration over receiving a memo from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) saying that the privilege granted to him had been withdrawn following a review of the travel arrangements and government rules on official travel. The notice was issued on Sept. 11, a few days before Reyes was supposed to fly to Spain to sign a co-production agreement. […]...
